candidates.excerpt: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan grants time till October 13, 2026, for the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption to file its written objections

candidates.excerpt: The Department of Labour is also suspending Microsoft and Adobe from the PERM programme

candidates.title: KTR Demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Resignation, Favours SC’s Suo Motu Action on SIR Irregularities
candidates.excerpt: "Gyanesh Kumar must go! No individual is above the institution," he said. The nation has seen many individuals come and go and it has survived beautifully. So why this desperation to protect one man, KTR asked.

candidates.title: TGSRTC Union Elections Begin after Nearly a Decade-long Gap
candidates.excerpt: The corporation has made elaborate security for the smooth conduct of the election at 115 polling booths across all the RTC depots in the State

candidates.title: Hyderabad: How a mother’s SOS led to 6 minors testing positive for drugs
candidates.excerpt: A Cyberabad mother approached the EAGLE Force helpline, worried about her son’s drug use and that of his minor friends

candidates.title: Siddipet celebrates 10 years as a district with a 10K run and public programmes
candidates.excerpt: Siddipet began celebrations marking its 10th anniversary as a district with a 10K run on Friday. Former minister T Harish Rao highlighted development under the BRS government and promised to establish a university if the party returns to power in 2028

candidates.excerpt: Gas leak triggers fire at IIT Bombay hostel, 5 injured    The Indian Express

candidates.title: Farmers protest power cuts in Addagudur, seek drought-hit status
candidates.excerpt: Farmers staged a protest in Addagudur of Yadadri-Bhongir district, demanding drought-hit status for the mandal and uninterrupted power supply. Backed by the BRS, they alleged that irregular electricity, inadequate irrigation water and delays in replacing burnt-out transformers threatened crops.

candidates.title: D Raja questions Delhi restrictions ahead of INDIA bloc demonstration
candidates.excerpt: CPI general secretary D Raja has condemned restrictions ahead of the October 10 Jantar Mantar protest, amid reports of train cancellations and disruption at 56 Metro stations. The INDIA bloc is set to discuss its campaign against alleged electoral irregularities

candidates.title: Scindia says satcom security clearance rests with Home Ministry, denies bias
candidates.excerpt: Communications minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said India does not allow monopoly in any sector and therefore even as Satcom (satellite communication) is concerned there is not a single licensee that has been chosen.

candidates.title: Local Body Elections Notification To Release After Gazette: SEC Punetha
candidates.excerpt: SEC Anil Chandra Punetha said that the government will issue a gazette notification finalising the reservations for the Andhra Pradesh local body elections, after which the election notification will follow.

candidates.title: Electoral roll row puts protest rights and public convenience in focus
candidates.excerpt: The Opposition’s campaign against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar has revived debate over protest rights and public convenience. While demonstrations are vital to democracy, disruptions to transport and daily life raise questions about civic responsibility, government accountability and peaceful dissent
